timeline.message:
Fix RepositoryAnalysisFailureIT

This test is supposed to trigger a failure by exposing a spurious value
for the register, but sometimes it exposes `expectedMax` which is what
we expect at the end of the register checks. With this commit we ensure
that we don't inadvertently return a correct value.

Closes #94410
timeline.author: David Turner

timeline.body:
This test is supposed to trigger a failure by exposing a spurious value for the register, but sometimes it exposes `expectedMax` which is what we expect at the end of the register checks. With this commit we ensure that we don't inadvertently return a correct value.

Closes #94410
NIT: I think `randomValueOtherThan(expectedMax, ESTestCase::randomLong)` would do the same.

reply.body: Kinda, except here I am deliberately choosing the "likely" wrong values with much higher probability.
